The '''Third Nantama Synod''' was a meeting of the Lords of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] that was held on the world [[Nantama]].

==The meeting==
Following the marriage of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Osted Picutorion]] to the Senex [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Farasa Anturi]] in [[553 BBY]], a conflict known as the [[Crimson Days]] broke out in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. A synod was held on the world Nantama and ended the conflict, by accepting Picutorion's marriage and the independence of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hutlar]], which Picutorion had liberated.
